偶々: by chance; by accident; accidentally; happen to (be, do)
解す: to disentangle; to untangle; to unravel; to loosen
遂に: finally; in the end; at last
断る: to refuse; to reject; to dismiss; to turn down
続き: continuation; rest (of the story, work, etc.); next installment; sequel
解く: to dispel (misunderstanding, etc.); to clear up; to remove (suspicion); to appease
解ける: to dissipate (of anger, tension, etc.); to melt away; to ease; to be allayed
ばっちり: perfectly; right on the mark; spot on; bang on
手持ち: in hand; on hand; on one; in stock
取れる: to be able to get; to be able to obtain; to be able to secure; to be able to win
得意: one's strong point; one's forte; one's specialty

__flags__.天然: お腹へってんねん = へっ+てん+ねん (ねん ending), not 'natural airhead'
__flags__.早: 早よ (Kansai 'hayo', quickly) adverbial fragment of 早く
__flags__.払い: 払たる = 払う (Kansai 払ったる), verb form not noun 'payment'
__flags__.作り: お造り (sashimi) -- different kanji 造り, acceptable
__flags__.小屋: ええとこや = いいところや, こや is a fragment (とこ+や), not 'hut'
__flags__.軽: 軽なる = 軽くなる (Kansai), adjective 軽い fragment
__flags__.一丁: いっちょ = interjection 'well then', set phrase いっちょやる
__flags__.張る: 張る here = to stake out/watch (張り込む), closest listed sense stick/stretch
